caption:
The wobbly chair

Cella lived with the wobbly chair for a year.

Most wobble comes from one leg a hair short, and a folded piece of paper under it usually fixes it.

For the friend who still has a coaster under one table leg.

Choose friction.

More of this: link in bio.

alt: A short film with no voice, with music. A room with a table. A small ink-black block figure with white eyes stands on the left beside a chair that rocks from side to side, again and again, with a small knock each time. The figure narrows its eyes at every wobble. At the end its eyes go wide and it trembles. The text changes from: me and the wobbly chair, one year, to: fix: one folded paper. wobble: gone.
